steps.code:
# Fetch contents of all habit log notes and extract date and ate_homemade_meals status.
import re
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

habit_data = []
for note_meta in all_notes:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=access_token, note_id=note_meta['note_id'])
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Log -- YYYY-MM-DD"
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    if not m:
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    # Parse content for ate_homemade_meals
    content = note['content']
    # Find line with ate_homemade_meals
    for line in content.split('\n'):
        if line.strip().startswith('ate_homemade_meals:'):
            value = line.split(':', 1)[1].strip().lower()
            habit_data.append((date_str, value == 'yes'))
            break

print(f"Parsed {len(habit_data)} habit entries")
print("Sample:", habit_data[:5])
